items.title: Arnold Loyacano Interview, 1956-09-29
items.q: I went back to Chicago with Happy Shillin. There's Happy Shillin and Georgie Borth, Johnny Fisher, and I and Johnny, let's say I think it was Johnny Frisco, who was the drummer.

ctx.x: Uh, they had what you call a... Bansick. Oh, yeah. Yeah, you know Frisco.
